description: Search the Port de Barcelona BIM object library (cranes, bollards, fenders, signs, buildings… IFC, CC BY 4.0) by words and category. Each hit has its IFC download URL and a link that opens it in the 3D viewer. Use it when the user needs port or maritime infrastructure objects for a model or twin.

category.description: Only this category (the answer lists them).

query.description: Words to look for in the object name, e.g. "grua", "bolardo", "crane". Empty lists everything.

name: search_port_library
title: Search the Port de Barcelona IFC library
